limitations: Label-conditional JSD and prior-shift use CICIDS2017 training vs each development/confirmation domain; it separates covariate-given-label shift from prior shift but cannot further separate concept shift from extractor shift.
Oracle-threshold MCC uses each domain's own labels to select the threshold and is a diagnostic upper bound on what rethresholding alone could achieve, not an unbiased or deployable estimate.
Recalibration is evaluated at seed 42 only, using stored raw predictions; the adaptation fold (2,000 flows) is a hypothetical small labeled budget, not validated across the ten-seed protocol.

Temperature scaling is monotonic and therefore leaves 0.5-threshold MCC/TPR/FPR unchanged by construction; only ECE/Brier/NLL can improve. Platt scaling can additionally shift the decision boundary and is reported for comparison.
